content.short: Blockscout lets you view, confirm, and inspect transactions on EVM-compatible blockchains.
content.description: Blockscout is the leading open-source block explorer used across more than 800 networks, rollups, L2s, and Layer 1 chains. Its intuitive interface makes it easy to run quick searches while also supporting deep investigations into blockchain data. Developers gain access to a robust API and smart contract verification tools, enabling efficient integration and auditing. The DAppscout marketplace offers a secure space for discovering, exploring, and interacting with decentralized applications. Blockscout is free to use, with an Explorer-as-a-Service option and listings in DAppscout.
